title: Compress restored helpers without changing the paid call word (no new κ)
body:
Prove that any exact k-call scalar-idempotent word with t nonidentity data targets and arbitrarily many exactly restored helpers has an equivalent word with w = rank_F2(V^T U) <= floor((k-t)/2) helpers. It preserves paid frames, call order, data components and all scalar pairings, with the complete new endpoint proved on arbitrary helper inputs.

For #4118's exactly restored subcase, five calls and three data targets reduce to at most one helper; #720 excludes zero helpers under its hypotheses. The four-register question and broader nonidentity-helper problem remain open. New relative to retained rank arguments: the constructive quotient preserves every endpoint block. Its minimum is restricted to the stated preservation contract.

Base: 7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a.
#4118 head: 9f7beec1af0085f576906c7972a18dfe73ac7b40.
#720 head: a942c0ae1b463710ca535c1fba1b07b6431b5a86.
Canonical blob/SHA256 pins are in SOURCES.json; replay is self-contained.

Reproduce (CPython 3.12, stdlib):
```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/restored-helper-compression
```
Expected: PASS_RESTORED_HELPER_COMPRESSION, PASS_C_INDEPENDENT_COMPRESSION_REVIEW and PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE.

Executed normal/-O: all 4,096 pairs of 2x3 helper matrices, 64 data-block checks, 16 structured words, 64 nested-inverse words (seed 2026110617), seven rejection controls. A separate implementation checks 448 factorizations, 181 full endpoints, 121 reductions and six counterexamples. Nonrestoration, zero frames, identity-target counting and false pairing/minimality claims are challenged. Proof/code reviews, committed bytes/modes, export integrity and four Git-free replays pass. Remote full tree matches.

No new κ. Nonzero calls, nonidentity targets and exact whole-matrix restoration are essential; the constructor does not certify those endpoint premises. No 120^5 census, native saving, supplier admission or human/formal acceptance. All five selected assumptions remain. No selected cold-replay PASS or full-history preflight claim.

By @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and separate verification/review. Credit Ali Romman (#468), eumemic (#288), waynenilsen's arbitrary-register treatment, David Govea (#720) and unpaidmoon (#4118). Apache-2.0.
